description: A column reps can see, filter and group by that is worked out from other fields rather than stored.

fields.label: List
fields.description: The list this field appears on. It cannot be changed once saved.

fields.label: Fieldname
fields.description: The name this field is addressed by, in lower case with underscores. It cannot be changed once saved.

fields.label: Label
fields.description: The column heading the rep sees, and the entry in every menu. Changing it moves all of them at once.

fields.label: Order Rows Within A Bucket By
fields.description: A column used to order rows within one bucket. Optional. The buckets themselves sort in the order declared below.

fields.label: Where It Is Offered
fields.description: The menus that carry the field, and whether it arrives on the list unasked. None of it is a permission.

fields.label: Surfaces
fields.description: The menus that offer the field: column, filter, sort, group_by, quick_filter. Blank offers it in all five.

fields.label: Shown By Default
fields.description: Show the column without the rep having to add it. Off by default.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Nothing reads this row until it is ticked. A saved but unticked row is inert.

fields.label: The Declaration
fields.description: The buckets. Order matters twice: the first bucket a record matches is what it shows, and that same order is how the field sorts.

fields.label: Buckets (JSON)
fields.description: An ordered list of buckets, each with the value the rep reads, a badge colour, and the conditions that put a record in it. A record no bucket claims shows an empty cell.

name: CRM Derived Field
